statement.text: Let $f(n)$ be maximal such that in any $A\subset \mathbb{Z}$ with $\lvert A\rvert=n$ there exists some sum-free subset $B\subseteq A$ with $\lvert B\rvert \geq f(n)$, so that there are no solutions to $ a+b=c $ with $a,b,c\in B$. Estimate $f(n)$.

title: Erdős Problem #792
